title: Identity transport of arbitrary constant-sheaf maps
statement: Let S,P be schemes [def-pc-scheme], s:P to S, F a sheaf on S and L its constructed inverse image [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let A be any set in Type (u+1), tau:C_P(A) to L_s(F) any morphism, with C constant sheafification [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For gamma [def-weil-pbc-etale-set-constant-pullback-comparison] and c [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], gamma_id inverse followed by L_id(tau) followed by c_{s,id,F} equals tau followed by the inverse identity-composition transport from L_s(F) to L_{id composed with s}(F). No invertibility of tau is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03CB, 03CC (inverse-image composition), 0B65 (comparison of adjoints), 03P5 (constant sheaves), and 0A3H final paragraph (equal-valued generators)

proof.text: Identify the identity inverse-image adjunction with the identity adjunction by restriction along Over.pullbackId. Its unit equation identifies the chosen composition comparison c_{s,id,F} with the identity comparison followed by the identity-composition cast: fixed-sheaf uniqueness applies on twice unit-pulled sections. Use Over.pullbackComp_id_left for the fibre-product unit law.

The constant comparison gamma_id has the same unit equation as the identity comparison on C_P(A), by its defining adjunction construction. Injectivity of the adjunction hom equivalence identifies them. Naturality with respect to tau cancels the two identity comparisons, leaving exactly the inverse identity-composition cast.

theorem etaleSetConstantTransportIdentity
    (S P : Scheme.{u}) (s : P ⟶ S)
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (A : Type (u + 1))
    (τ : (constantSheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).obj A ⟶
      (Scheme.etaleSetPullback s).obj F) :
    (etaleSetConstantPullbackComparison (𝟙 P)).inv.app A ≫
        (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (𝟙 P)).map τ ≫
        ((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2)
          S P P s (𝟙 P)).hom.app F =
      τ ≫ eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun k : P ⟶ S ↦ (Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj F)
        (Category.id_comp s)).symm
